reasons.detail: R1 — `--help` handling moved after plugin dispatch so `workflow --help` can be served by workflow plugin code instead of shared help.
R2 — Added test coverage explicitly asserts workflow help output contains all listed workflow subcommands.
R3 — Shared plugin-package help is now only fallback after dispatch, preventing `Plugin: workflow` being primary for `workflow --help`.
R4 — Tests assert `senti help workflow` still shows package-level header (`Plugin: workflow`) and workflow command row.
R5 — Spec includes explicit assertions for `senti help`, `senti plugin --help`, and `senti plugin find --help`, preserving behavior contract.
R6 — `workflow` is still passed into plugin dispatch without forcing shared help first, so non-help path remains plugin command dispatch.
R7 — For unknown command with `--help`, shared-help fallback in this diff only occurs inside namespace-dispatched branch, preventing successful rendered help for non-existent commands.
R8 — New spec file includes header declaring all requirements and exercises both command-level and package-level plugin help paths.
